checks.name: every day from the first to the last ticket has one row
checks.sql: select (select date_diff('day', min(opened_on), max(opened_on)) + 1 from raw.tickets) - (select count(distinct ticket_date) from main.daily_tickets) + (select count(*) - count(distinct ticket_date) from main.daily_tickets)

checks.name: a quiet day counts zero tickets
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.daily_tickets d where not exists (select 1 from raw.tickets t where t.opened_on = d.ticket_date) and (d.tickets is null or d.tickets <> 0)

checks.name: days with tickets are unchanged
checks.sql: select count(*) from (select opened_on, count(*) as n from raw.tickets group by opened_on) r left join main.daily_tickets d on d.ticket_date = r.opened_on where d.tickets is distinct from r.n
